annotations.title: Daily history for one tokenized asset

description: Daily snapshots of total TVL and TVL-weighted APY for one symbol, optionally on one chain, over the last N days (default 30; Free and anonymous plans see 7, Pro the full history). universe "rwa" (tokenized assets, default) or "stablecoin" (stablecoin pools). Includes the change from first to last day.
